scope: Read-only current tracked tree, selected input/render/report/storage modules, Google authentication code, standard secret signatures in tracked tree and history. No current GitHub account or remote used for writes. No provider login attempted.

confirmedChecks.vendorFalsePositive: An API-key-shaped sequence was confirmed inside a 3.8 MB base64 WebAssembly string; not a standalone key/configuration value.
confirmedChecks.maliciousExportProbe: HTML title/organizer/platform/author/source/grouping text escaped; javascript URL and SVG data image rejected. Parsed exported HTML: zero scripts, event attributes or unsafe URL attributes.
confirmedChecks.googleStorage: Credential is not persisted or logged. Verified profile stays in tab memory with expiry. No server session or cloud sync is claimed or implemented.
confirmedChecks.staticPortability: Relative local modules, fonts, OCR worker/core/languages and assets. Buildless dist runs via Python HTTP server; START.command executable and falls back to PATH Python. No >100 MB GitHub file blocker.

transferNotes: New GitHub owner/repository URL is required before push. Do not use existing connector/account/remote to infer destination.

Copy only intended project source; exclude .git, .openai/local, runtime artifacts and personal browser data. Existing .openai/hosting.json is a platform binding, not a secret; decide deliberately whether to retain it in an independent hosting copy.
Public OAuth Client ID is not a client secret. If hosting domain changes, add the exact new HTTPS origin in Google Auth Platform. Moving source to GitHub alone does not change OAuth origins.
Google Cloud publication/audience/test-user status cannot be established from repository code and was not checked in this read-only audit.
New hosting requires privacy-page hosting description to match the actual provider. Existing Sites description remains correct while only source is copied to GitHub.

Use HTTPS or localhost for browser APIs. Loading via an insecure LAN HTTP address can fail at google-auth.mjs:6 (crypto.randomUUID is secure-context only); current documented localhost and public HTTPS are supported.
limits: Pattern scanning and bounded probes are not a full penetration test, dependency-vulnerability audit, external Google configuration verification, or proof of absence of all secrets. No code or historical reports were changed.
